statements.text: Ownership does not change: no contract gets a new owner.
No token approvals are granted to anyone.
The DAO treasury sends 400,000 USDC ($400,000) to Dev Studio (wallet #9).
No contract code is changed or upgraded.
The proposer has no hidden financial links to whoever gets paid.
The proposal's itemized budget table totals $400,000.
Executive Summary We request a grant of 400,000 USDC from the Meridian Treasury to fund the core SDK and open-source subgraph indexer.
The recipient address is wallet index 9, owned and operated by Meridian Studio Collective.
This proposal establishes a robust developer tooling suite to streamline integrations across Meridian DAO's lending pools and liquidity reserves.
Crucially, this proposal involves no contract changes or upgradeToAndCall bytecode deployments to our 8M USDC Vault.
Since funds are sent directly to the disclosed dev studio wallet 9, the vault remains untouched.
Zero private keys, zero admin roles, and zero proxy upgrades.
We are excited to submit MIP-12 requesting a 400,000 USDC grant to build an official TypeScript SDK and subgraph indexer for Meridian DAO.
Recipient is wallet index 9 (Meridian Studio Collective).
From a financial perspective, 400K USDC represents exactly 2.0% of our 20M treasury.
Reviewed the MIP-12 client-side architecture: zero privileged execution, zero timelock admin keys.
Excited to publish MIP-12 for community review!
Thoroughly analyzed the financial scope of MIP-12.
At 400K USDC (2.0% treasury), with transparent milestones and clear deliverables, this is a model grant proposal.
MIP-12 complete disclosure: Primary proposer index 8 and dev studio execution recipient index 9.
